newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN JUNE FOREX TURNOVER AT US$4.532 BLN.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN JUNE FOREX TURNOVER AT US$4.532 BLN.

text.p: Average daily turnover in Taiwan's foreign exchange market in June totalled US$4.532 billion, the central bank said on Friday.
The central bank did not give comparsion figures.

Of the daily turnover, 20.4 percent was between the U.S. dollar and the yen and 12.4 percent was between the dollar and the mark. Trade among the Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies accounted for 46.3 percent of the total.
Spot trading took 68.3 percent of the total, cross-currency swaps 11.6 percent, margin trading 11.0 percent, forward trading 7.6 percent, options and futures 1.5 percent.
Taiwan started financial derivatives trading in early 1994.
